text:
Anonymous post for another group member
Hi everyone,

My husband and I are married and have an 9 month old daughter. We recently had our A/5 interview and waiting for response, but our relationship has become very destabilizing for me.

I’m alone with the baby most of the time and carry almost all of the responsibilities of her by myself. I don’t work and I’m completely financially dependent on my husband. I have no income of my own and only have money when I ask him for it, which makes me feel completely stuck and powerless.

 I would like to find a job and become independent. The problem is that I don’t feel I can continue in this relationship anymore. There is a constant sense of imbalance and control, and I don’t feel emotionally safe because my husband ignores my requests for help and support.  he also doesn’t seem willing to talk about a dealing, divorce, financial support, child support, or whether I could remain in Israel also without our relationship . He just says to me “ do what you want”. 

I feel like I’m living in limbo, not knowing where I belong or what options I have. Has anyone been in a similar situation? What are my rights regarding my daughter, my legal status in Israel? Are there any organizations or professionals I can contact for advice?

Thank you to anyone who takes the time to respond.
